did: Landed the flow card (CARDS5, #2985) after a fresh review caught a step rising into the stamp's strip and an arrow from a step not yet shown, and moved the command type and drawing the cheat sheet and flow shared into one place. Opened the cheat-sheet series and the two showcase cut lists (#2986), each rendering the same bytes twice. Built the fix for a card's later badge being counted as seen before it spelled itself out (#2982), held to the cards' own frames, and handed it on.

calls.title: Where the showcase videos' cut lists live
options: In the repo beside their series
Only in the issue that wrote them
calls.why: A cut list in the repo can be rendered and tested by anyone; a video is bytes no one can re-derive.
calls.undo: Delete packages/video-render/src/sample/videos and its series test case.

left: #2982's fix is pushed on badge-seen-reveal with no PR: it opens after #2986 merges, once main is merged in and the full checks pass.
A rendered sample video lands untracked under src/ until .gitignore ignores sample/videos/*/outputs/, which only a person may edit.
